notes:
Need to search first.I don't have any notes on Job 3 to give you yet. None of the sources were retrieved, and I've used up my tool calls for this turn.

My first attempt tried to open the commentary pages directly: Enduring Word, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary and Gill on biblehub, Precept Austin and the NET Bible notes. The fetch tool refused all six because it only opens addresses that have already come up in a search. My second attempt was a batch of searches meant to find those addresses and some tradition-specific pages: GotQuestions on 3:25 ("the thing I feared"), Leviathan in 3:8, whether Job sinned by cursing his birthday, and Spurgeon, Desiring God and Wesley on this chapter. It was blocked before it ran.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge, so I haven't written any verse notes.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll:
1. Search first to get valid addresses.
2. Read the verse-by-verse sources: Enduring Word, Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit and Precept Austin.
3. Read pages on the likely points of difference:
   - whether Job's lament was sinful or allowable;
   - what Leviathan means in v. 8;
   - v. 25, which word-of-faith teachers use to say fear brought Job's troubles on him, and the replies to that;
   - Catholic and Orthodox readings, plus the NET Bible notes for modern scholarship.
4. Write the notes verse by verse, with a URL for every point.
